id="notes" value="UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys.<br>Friendship pair UNIQUE(userOneId,userTwoId); UserBlock PK(blockerId,blockedUserId); UserRole UNIQUE(userId,roleId). Cross-service user references and refresh replacement IDs are not database foreign keys. Multiplicity describes each named role; two-role links do not mean one shared user.<br>role: roleId to id (declared SQL FK); user: userId to id (logical) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); token owner: userId to id (logical) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); requester: requesterId to User.id (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); recipient: recipientId to User.id; logical scalar IDs, no cross-service FK; blocker: blockerId to User.id (scalar-ID<br>association; no declared FK); blocked user: blockedUserId to User.id; logical scalar IDs, no cross-service FK; successor: replacedByTokenId: optional logical successor (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)" vertex="1" parent="1" xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys.
Friendship pair UNIQUE(userOneId,userTwoId); UserBlock PK(blockerId,blockedUserId); UserRole UNIQUE(userId,roleId). Cross-service user references and refresh replacement IDs are not database foreign keys. Multiplicity describes each named role; two-role links do not mean one shared user.
role: roleId to id (declared SQL FK); user: userId to id (logical) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); token owner: userId to id (logical) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); requester: requesterId to User.id (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); recipient: recipientId to User.id; logical scalar IDs, no cross-service FK; blocker: blockerId to User.id (scalar-ID
association; no declared FK); blocked user: blockedUserId to User.id; logical scalar IDs, no cross-service FK; successor: replacedByTokenId: optional logical successor (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)
